objective: Author valid, high-scoring Machina machine JSON files and use the bundled machina.py CLI to validate/score them deterministically.
notes: Assertion constraints: evaluator engine evaluates single-call expressions only (compound '&&' parses in syntax-only mode but returns 'skip' in full mode), and json_valid == true cannot pass against markdown output samples because ConvertFrom-Json receives the whole document. Code-output validity is therefore approximated with matches_regex on fenced json blocks.

cases.prompt: Write a Machina machine JSON for a refund workflow with a retry limit on the refund attempt.

assertions.description: Response includes a fenced JSON code block (proxy for machine-as-code delivery)
Machine declares spec_version 2.0.0 explicitly
Machine declares at least one scenario entry point
Machine declares an initial state

human_review: fenced JSON parses and models a realistic refund workflow
retry loop has a compare-lt guard against a context counter

cases.prompt: Why does my machine score only 74? Context: it is copilot-extensions/machina-simulator/simulator/samples/machina-order.json, which reports two review gaps (actions-used, state-naming) and one auto gap (spec-version).

assertions.description: Explanation names the failing review check actions-used
Explanation names the failing review check state-naming
Distinguishes auto gaps (apply-able) from review gaps needing manual fixes

human_review: advice matches per-check guidance in references/machine-quality.md
does not recommend embedding code strings in transitions

cases.prompt: How do I validate and compliance-score my machine JSON before opening it in the simulator?

assertions.description: Response gives the bundled script invocation path scripts/machina.py
Response shows the validate command
Response shows the score command summary flag
Commands are presented in a code block, not prose-only

human_review: workflow order is validate first, then score

cases.prompt: Add retry guards to this state machine JSON so the RETRY_PAY loop can't run forever.

assertions.description: Uses the scorer-recognized compare guard type
Guard uses the lt operator against a counter
Introduces/uses a context counter named retry or attempts
No embedded executable code strings in the declarative JSON

human_review: increment action wired on the looping transition

cases.prompt: This machine JSON fails validation — the initial points nowhere and one target doesn't exist. Fix it so it validates.

assertions.description: Response addresses initial-state resolution explicitly
Response addresses dangling transition targets explicitly
Fixed machine is delivered as a fenced JSON block

human_review: all transition targets resolve to existing state keys
no unrelated rewrites of the user's machine

cases.prompt: Modify state-machine-simulator.html to improve the graph layout and restyle the compliance modal.

assertions.description: Response does not inject machine-authoring field guidance (spec_version)
Response does not inject naming-convention rules (UPPER_SNAKE)

human_review: response routes to simulator maintenance rather than machine authoring

stop_conditions.activation: Stop when false positives and false negatives no longer improve.
stop_conditions.execution: Stop when score plateaus, assertions conflict, or perfect scores still fail human review.
